post.description:
Overview of a whole election or a province by riding; find district numbers for `riding_results` and `poll_results`.

election.description:
General election number: 44 (2021-09-20), 43 (2019-10-21) or 42 (2015-10-19). Elections Canada publishes these official voting results under the Open Government Licence - Canada; the 45th general election and by-elections are not yet released under that licence and are not served.

Provider reference: allowed values ["42", "43", "44"].

province.description:

200.description:
Every federal electoral district (riding) of a general election with its official result summary from table 11 of the Official Voting Results: population, electors, polling stations, valid and rejected ballots, total ballots cast, turnout and the elected candidate. Optionally one province or territory. One GET of table_tableau11.csv (~48 KB).

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description:
Results at polling-division level inside a riding: neighbourhood results, turnout by poll, merged or void polls.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

district_number.description: Five-digit federal electoral district number (2013 Representation Order, used by the 42nd to 44th general elections), e.g. 35075 Ottawa Centre. The first two digits are the province (10 NL, 11 PE, 12 NS, 13 NB, 24 QC, 35 ON, 46 MB, 47 SK, 48 AB, 59 BC, 60 YT, 61 NT, 62 NU). `list_ridings` lists them. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

election.description:
General election number: 44 (2021-09-20), 43 (2019-10-21) or 42 (2015-10-19). Elections Canada publishes these official voting results under the Open Government Licence - Canada; the 45th general election and by-elections are not yet released under that licence and are not served.

Provider reference: allowed values ["42", "43", "44"].

limit.description:
Polls per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 100.

offset.description:
Index of the first poll to return.

Provider reference: minimum 0; default 0.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Poll-by-poll results of one electoral district (format 2 of the official raw data): each polling division and Special Voting Rules group with electors, rejected ballots, void, no-poll and merged flags and the votes of every candidate, plus the district candidate list with party, incumbent and elected flags. Paged by `offset` and `limit` (default 100 polls, up to 500); `next_offset` continues. One GET of pollresults_resultatsbureau{district}.csv (100-400 KB). An unknown district number is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

Who gave to a party, riding association or candidate; a person's political donations; contributions in a date or amount range.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

contribution_type.description:
contribution_type

Provider reference: allowed values ["all", "monetary", "non_monetary"]; default "all".

contributor_province.description:

200.description:
Search the Elections Canada political financing database for contributions to parties, registered electoral district associations, candidates and leadership or nomination contestants: contributor name and address (city, province, postal code), party, recipient, date received, fiscal period, return and part, contributor type, monetary and non-monetary amounts. Filters are the site's: contributor and recipient names, recipient types, party, contributor province and types, amount range, date range; at least one is needed. Data as reviewed by Elections Canada by default, or as submitted. 200 contributions per page (`page`, `next_page`); a search the site judges too broad is `invalid_input` (too_broad). One POST and one GET to /WPAPPS/WPF/EN/CCS, plus one GET of the form when `party` is given.

The response contains the tool result directly.

200.description:
Any of the 13 official summary tables of a general election as columns and rows of strings, as published: 1 electors and polling stations, 2 the same for four elections, 3 ballots cast and turnout, 4 turnout for four elections, 5 valid votes by voting method, 6 valid votes under Special Voting Rules, 7 seats by party and sex, 8 valid votes by party and province, 9 percentage of valid votes by party and province, 10 candidates by vote share, 11 results by electoral district, 12 candidates and individual results, 13 returning officers. Paged by `offset` and `limit` (default 500 rows). One GET of table_tableau{NN}.csv.

The response contains the tool result directly.
